description: 自転車等駐車場等 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿児島市. 自転車等駐車場と放置自転車等一時保管所データ. Coverage: 鹿児島市. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿児島市. Its tags are 一時保管所, 放置自転車, 自転車, 駐車場. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-04-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
